authority: User S-L1A/B/C/D acceptance and S-L1C v2 near-range tracking instruction
purpose: Improve genuine off-row sphere recall without increasing matched false association. CPU NO-GO stops before production/GPU implementation.
sensor_contract: RGB-D Camera + LiDAR; frozen Policy F 898-D; no semantic/GT input to association

candidates.V2-A: Keep every v1 decision. For a v1 rejection, fit the declared 0.20m sphere to at least two valid rows of the prediction-nearest azimuth column. Infer centre-distance roots from measured ray ranges and the track direction, take their median, and require its distance from the prediction below the unchanged association gate. Re-render the sphere analytically on these four rays. Require max sphere residual <=max(0.001m,3*noise_bound), and the equal-horizontal-range vertical-surface max residual to exceed sphere residual by >max(0.001m,4*noise_bound). Reject an unexpected near-band return on a ray the fitted sphere cannot reach. No measurement labels or GT enter this rule. Newly accepted centre distance is the fitted sphere distance; existing v1 accepted measurements remain unchanged.
candidates.V2-B: V1 fallback plus V2-A sphere/vertical test and azimuth-extent discrimination. The extra horizontal discriminator is only conclusive when the sphere angular radius is strictly below the 5-degree column pitch. Otherwise do not add an acceptance (ABSTAIN_AZIMUTH). Also veto near-band adjacent-column returns outside the predicted sphere. No adaptive widening.
candidates.V2-C: CPU-only unconstrained shape-rejection removal: eligible range-gated returns are identity-unconfirmed. Measure its recall/false association, but selection is INELIGIBLE_CONTRACT until a separate 5s fused-recency/identity proof is preregistered. No production C implementation or clock change is authorized automatically.

eq1d.source: EQ1D-R1 frozen rendered scans/layout, priming bar first-hit+0.15m along declared bearing

cpu.noise_realizations: Zero noise once; each positive bound twice with deterministic alternating-row/column +/- bound and its negation. Do not perturb no-return=12m.
cpu.eligibility: A genuine-hit opportunity requires an independent sphere first-hit in the prediction-nearest azimuth column. Report all no-hit/no-eligible cases separately. Accepted first-hit BOX is false association even in a scene containing a sphere. No outcome-dependent denominator.

gates.CPU-RECALL: Strictly greater genuine-hit recall than v1 pooled over the four primary near ranges, and no loss in any mandatory range/elevation/bearing/radial-offset stratum with a nonempty opportunity denominator. No paired accepted true return may be lost. Evaluate primary noise bounds separately.
gates.CPU-NEG: No additional accepted BOX first-hit in any matched negative or mixed foreground case at any declared noise bound; EQ1D seven unique negatives remain zero at primary bounds. Report inherited distant v1 residual accepts, never relabel as true targets.
gates.CPU-RANGE: Existing v1 acceptances keep identical row/range. Newly accepted genuine targets: zero-noise centre error <=0.001m and bounded-primary-noise <=0.02m. Angular-error diagnostics reported separately and cannot be claimed qualified if outside these limits.
gates.CPU-SELECT: Only A or B can be eligible. All recall/negative/range gates must pass simultaneously. Among passing candidates maximize newly correct primary acceptances, then minimize false accepts, then new range MAE, then prefer A for simplicity. No passing candidate => NO-GO, no production/GPU implementation.
gates.C-COV: Unobserved orthogonal posterior variances >=0.99 of prior; radial variance decreases on accepted range-only updates, as v1. No covariance change.
gates.C-CLOCK: Camera alone resets identity age. LiDAR range never resets identity age; fused recency behavior unchanged. 51 consecutive misses expire the 5s tracker. No clock code change.
gates.C-REGRESSION: Legacy and A/B/C/D v1: bitwise current-source CPU perception/detector checks versus aed6aff, plus GPU 600-step 14-key logs matching their frozen qualified sources. S-L1D v1 is not combined automatically with v2.
gates.C-FIREWALL: Only declared sensor ranges/ray table, current camera validity and tracker prediction/active/gate enter the helper. No GT/semantic/provenance online. Actor898/checkpoint/RMS unchanged. E-L0 P1=P2 on v2.
gates.GPU-RECALL-NEG: Same paired no-loss/no-additional-BOX conditions on predeclared rendered fixtures; pooled near recall strictly improves; report by distance/elevation and all abstentions. CPU selection is not a GPU PASS.
gates.GO: CPU selection, range/covariance/clocks, all previous-mode regressions, GPU recall/negative and E-L0/firewall/integrity PASS, preservation verified, independent Fable5.1 review without unresolved blocker. Otherwise NO-GO or INCOMPLETE. No post-result tolerance relaxation.

gpu.negative_description: 7 original EQ1D negatives rendered with their original layout; 12 tall/narrow bars: six mandatory ranges x widths0.02/0.6; 12 mixed foreground scenes: six ranges x gaps0.05/0.3, elevation5,bearing0. Compare actual rendered geometry, do not assume desired label.
gpu.stop: fixed committed source/clean tree; per-process and total watchdog, disk/OOM/head/import/RMS/manifest/nonfinite/noninterference guards; preserve partial output and stop, no retry

lineage.cumulative: S-L1A + S-L1B + selected S-L1C v2; retain v1 clock/covariance
lineage.s_l1d: disabled on v2; diagnostics API compatibility tested separately, no inheritance of S-L1D v1 qualification
